$description: Shokunin Crafthouse · Primitives · raw token values · single source of truth. Generated from Figma Primitives collection (VariableCollectionId:2013:2). Anchors marked in token descriptions are the values extracted directly from stages/02-design/design-system-preview.html; non-anchored values are derived (palette interpolation, alpha steps, etc.) and called out per-token.

$metadata.spacingBase: Hybrid 4/8pt layout ladder + 2pt micro ladder. Layout: 4·8·12·16·24·32·48·64·80·96·120 px. Micro (chrome only): 2·6·10·14·18·22 px. Arbitrary px outside these ladders is a bug.
$metadata.fontStrategy: Two families. Sans = Neue Haas Grotesk Display Pro (self-hosted woff2 in /fonts/, Helvetica Neue → Inter fallback while sourcing). Mono = Cascadia Mono (Google Fonts CDN). Weights 300/400/500 in active use across both families; weight 600 reserved for the secondary-button hover bump only — no other approved use. NHG mono evaluation (Geist, JetBrains, IBM Plex) closed; see decisions/decisions.md 2026-05-26.

50.$description: Lightest cream · derived 50% toward white from step 100. For ultra-soft fills.

100.$description: Oatmeal page ground · anchor from HTML --bg. Foundation of every light surface.

200.$description: Set-in component surface · anchor from HTML --surface. Cards, frames, raised tiles.

250.$description: Default hairline rule · anchor from HTML --hairline. 1px solid divisions.

300.$description: Sunk surface · anchor from HTML --surface-deep. Form inputs, card hover, nested states.

350.$description: Subtle hairline · anchor from HTML --hairline-2. Dashed inner divisions.

400.$description: Faint warm gray · anchor from HTML --ink-faint. Disabled text and decorative marks (fails AA by spec).

500.$description: Muted warm gray · anchor from HTML --ink-muted. Secondary copy, metadata, eyebrows.

600.$description: Mid-deep · derived between 500 and 800. Reserved for future deep-mid surfaces.

700.$description: Near-ink · derived between 500 and 800. Reserved for future near-ink surfaces.

800.$description: Ink · anchor from HTML --ink. Primary text, strong rules.

900.$description: Bar deep · anchor from HTML --bg-deep. Dark surface, colophon, future dark mode ground.

50.$description: Lightest vermilion wash · derived. For soft accent backgrounds.

100.$description: Pale vermilion · derived. Soft accent fills.

200.$description: Light vermilion · derived. Accent surface tints.

300.$description: Mid-light vermilion · derived. Used for dark-mode interactive states.

400.$description: Mid vermilion · derived. Dark-mode hover/active accent color.

500.$description: Vermilion · 朱 · anchor from HTML --shu. The single chromatic accent. Brand-identity-only (live site uses brass).

700.$description: Deep vermilion · anchor from HTML --shu-deep. Pressed/active accent, AA-passing text on light surfaces.

800.$description: Deeper vermilion · derived. Future high-contrast accent uses.

light.$description: Warm olive · success states on light ground. Passes AA on warmGray.100 (~4.7:1).

dark.$description: Lifted olive · success states on dark ground. Inverted-mode equivalent of success.light.

light.$description: Deep ochre · warning states on light ground. Passes AA on warmGray.100 (~4.5:1).

dark.$description: Lifted ochre · warning states on dark ground.

light.$description: Warm slate · info states on light ground. Passes AA on warmGray.100 (~5.1:1).

dark.$description: Lifted slate · info states on dark ground.

surfacePage.$description: Dark-mode page ground · from site --ground. Same value as warmGray.900 but role-named for dark-surface clarity.

surfaceSunk.$description: Dark-mode set-in surface · from site --tile-filled. Cards in dark mode (visually LIGHTER than page; role inverts perceptually).

surfaceDeepSunk.$description: Dark-mode deeper surface · derived. Nested states in dark mode.

textDisabled.$description: Dark-mode disabled text · derived (fails AA by spec).

white.$description: Pure white · utility primitive. Used by semantic text-on-accent and accent fill text.

black.$description: Pure black · utility primitive. Reserved for special shadow alpha bases.

sans.$description: Primary sans serif · display + body. Self-hosted woff2 from /fonts/; falls back to Helvetica Neue → Inter when NHG not loaded.

mono.$description: Monospace · chrome + code. Eyebrows, badges, buttons, timestamps, code surfaces. Loaded from Google Fonts CDN. Selected over Geist/JetBrains/Plex — see decisions/decisions.md 2026-05-26.

11.$description: 11px · type scale step (modular ratio 1.25). UI eyebrows, badges, buttons.

13.$description: 13px · type scale step. Captions, muted secondary copy.

14.$description: 14px · type scale step. Secondary body copy.

16.$description: 16px · type scale step. Body copy default.

light.$description: Light · 300. Display weight for premise statements and large headlines.

medium.$description: Medium · 500. UI labels, button text, section titles, eyebrows.

semibold.$description: Semibold · 600. Secondary button hover weight bump only — no other approved use.

flat.$description: Flat · 1.0. Display specimens at 120px, vertical alignment.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed · 1.55. Long-read prose, captions in cards.

wider.$description: Wider · 0.06em. Mono caps at 11px in chrome.

caps.$description: Caps · 0.1em. Premium small caps treatment for sub-sections.

2.$description: 2px · chrome micro-spacing (2pt ladder). Component padding, badge insets, mono caps compensation.

none.$description: No radius. Reserved for special structural rectangles.

input.$description: Form input + badge radius. Small, just enough to read as soft.

default.$description: Default radius. Cards, buttons, frames, stamps.

circle.$description: Pill / full circle. Status dots, brand stamp.

orchestrated.$description: 720ms · page, route, choreographed reveal. Justify anything longer in writing.

out.$description: Quint-out · primary easing. Hover, state changes, most things that ease in or out.

outStrong.$description: Strong quint-out · press/release. From levibahn.com convention.

cinematic.$description: Long deliberate · orchestrated only. Page transitions.

pressButton.$description: Button press scale · 0.985. Subtle confirmation press (levibahn.com).

pressTap.$description: Tap target press scale · 0.92. Heavier touch affordance.
